name: codex-agent-harness
description: Run repository changes through durable checks, independent Claude review, and verified delivery writing while Codex remains the lead.

interface.shortDescription: Durable coding loop with independent review
interface.longDescription: Codex leads repository changes, records an immutable task contract and check evidence, uses Claude Opus as a fresh independent critic, and prepares Jira, testing, PR, and review text from the verified implementation.
defaultPrompt: Implement this repository change through the durable Agent Harness workflow.
Review the current changes with an independent Claude critic and Codex triage.
Check whether the local Claude subscription runtime is ready without invoking a model.
Draft Jira and PR delivery text from the verified implementation using the project's writing conventions.
